title: Top-k per Row
signature: def top_k(x: np.ndarray, k: int) -> tuple
hints: np.argsort sorts ascending. Sorting -x sorts x descending.
Ties must go to the lower index. A stable sort keeps equal elements in their original order, so use kind="stable".
np.take_along_axis(x, idx, axis=1) gathers the values for an index matrix.
